name: Self-Determination Theory
athlete: Athletes keep going when they feel competent, in control and connected.
product: Crews, personal milestones and choice-led challenges are built around those three needs.

name: Habit formation
product: Streaks and weekly rhythms reward showing up, and quiet weeks never count as a zero.

name: Goal-gradient effect
athlete: Motivation rises as the finish line gets closer.
product: Challenge and route progress keeps that finish line visible.

name: Social belonging
athlete: People move more with a group they identify with.
product: Crews and local leaderboards are scoped to the athlete's own area and pace.
